questions.question: Change 3 l to millilitres and 4 500 ml to litres and millilitres.
questions.expected_answer: 3 l is 3 times 1 000, which is 3 000 ml. 4 500 ml divided by 1 000 is 4 with 500 left over, so it is 4 l 500 ml.

questions.question: How many millilitres are in a quarter of a litre and in three quarters of a litre?
questions.expected_answer: A quarter of 1 000 ml is 250 ml. Three quarters is 3 times 250, which is 750 ml.

questions.question: A 5 l bottle is poured into 250 ml glasses. How many glasses does it fill?
questions.expected_answer: Change to the same unit: 5 l is 5 000 ml. 5 000 divided by 250 is 20, so it fills 20 glasses.
